error[ZBX-E0421]: no data directory to keep the store in
  cause  neither XDG_DATA_HOME nor HOME names an absolute directory to keep it
         in
  fix    name one:   export XDG_DATA_HOME=$HOME/.local/share
  more   zbx explain E0421 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0421.html
